name: MS-Cloud graph ingestion -- graph the entire Microsoft cloud via the m365 server / Graph API
description: NFRA_EXPAND Strand A (Andrew-direct 2026-06-25, the big expansion). Use the m365 MCP gateway's live delegated Graph API access to ingest the MS cloud into the globgrph graph as nodes/edges: users/groups/mailboxes/SharePoint/OneDrive/Teams/calendars/files + relationships (owns/has-access/member-of/shared-with/located-in) + activity/freshness metadata. Graph grows from Opal-AWS+repo to + the entire MS cloud = SSOT for all Opal properties. HARD PRIVACY: model STRUCTURE+METADATA+ACTIVITY only, NEVER content; the sensitive sub-graph is access-controlled (least-priv read role, not the open comp-kuzu surface); de-identify person-data.

prds.label: Strand A scope: MS-cloud Graph-API ingestion + the structure-not-content privacy guardrail
